about: Every repo a HAX release (ubiquity) touches, and the ones it deliberately leaves out. scripts/ubiquity-network.mjs reads this: `versions` (the release version gate), `preflight` (every checkout is there, on its branch, with its tools, before anything changes), `coverage` (every repo PRAW's network and ecosystem map name is listed here or excluded), `landed` (the release is public before satellites rebuild) and `satellites` (refresh, version, tag and push the satellite repos). Paths are relative to $HAXTHEWEB_ROOT (default ~/haxtheweb). phase core: built, versioned and published by ubiquity-push.sh's own steps. phase satellite: refreshed, versioned and tagged by `satellites` after `landed` passes, so their deploys pick up a release that is already public. versionFile: the file holding the repo's version (package.json, pyproject.toml or a plain text file); the version gate needs .version past every one of them. tag: commit-and-tag-version (bumps versionFile and tags), direct (git tag only), or none. publish: npm package name ubiquity publishes, checked by `landed`. landed: a public URL whose body must be the release version once the release is live. deploy: what pushing the branch deploys.

repos.deploy: Vercel: cdn.hax.cloud, which haxtheweb.org, learn, art and every CDN-loaded HAXsite load from
Vercel: hax.cloud, built from haxcms-nodejs main and webcomponents master, so it goes after the release is public
Vercel: rpg.art.hax.cloud (rpg-me.hax.cloud redirects there), rebuilt from the push; one of HAX Art's tools, linked from the art site's menu, so it goes before art
Vercel: art.hax.cloud (the hax-art portfolio, loads HAX from cdn.hax.cloud at runtime; its menu links to RPG me); GitHub Pages: haxtheweb.github.io/art (the whole repo, for the interactive pieces)
GitHub Pages: learn.hax.cloud (loads HAX from cdn.hax.cloud)
GitHub Pages: haxtheweb.org (loads HAX from cdn.hax.cloud)

local: elmsln and the waxam mirror are maintainer-machine targets outside $HAXTHEWEB_ROOT; ubiquity-push.sh copies into them when they exist and preflight only warns when they don't.

excluded.reason: the unified issue queue, not a release target
